nodes.name: PII Scrubber (Privacy Shield)
nodes.notes: Strips emails, phone numbers, URLs, IPs, social handles, self-identification phrases, and zip codes from feedback text before it reaches any external API or storage.

nodes.name: Groq: Sentiment Analysis
nodes.notes: Receives ONLY sanitized feedback (PII already stripped). Uses Groq free tier with llama-3.1-8b-instant.

nodes.name: Anonymize & Strip Identifiers
nodes.notes: Calls Apps Script to create an anonymized copy of the sheet (strips Timestamps, replaces row IDs with anonymous IDs, removes any PII columns) before PDF export.

parameters.subject: =Survey Results - Event Complete (Anonymized)
parameters.message:
=The survey for your event has closed after the 5-hour window.

Please find the anonymized results attached as a PDF.

Note: All respondent data has been anonymized. Timestamps, IP addresses,
email addresses, and any personally identifiable information have been
stripped from this report. Respondents are identified only by anonymous
IDs (e.g., R-A1B2C3).

nodes.name: Purge Raw Response Data
nodes.notes: After email is sent, purge the raw response data from the original sheet. Only the anonymized sentiment results remain.
